use_when: 蜂窝通信
电话
短信
SIM卡
移动数据
如何在应用中拨打电话（三方应用拉起系统电话应用）？
如何监听通话状态变化（拨号、振铃、接通、挂断等）？
如何判断电话号码是否为紧急号码？
如何创建和发送短信消息？
如何获取和设置短信服务中心地址？
如何查询设备是否具备短信收发能力？
如何获取当前注册网络的名称、服务状态和信号强度？
如何管理蜂窝数据连接？
如何查询SIM卡状态信息（服务提供商、国家码等）？
如何管理eSIM卡？
当你的应用需要拨打电话或监听设备通话状态时，例如在通讯录应用中实现一键拨号、在客服系统中自动拨打服务热线，或者在来电管理应用中识别来电状态，你应该使用 Telephony Kit 的 call 模块
当你的应用需要发送或管理短信时，例如实现验证码短信发送、通知短信推送、短信网关对接等功能，你应该使用 Telephony Kit 的 sms 模块
同时，如果你需要获取设备网络状态、SIM卡信息或管理蜂窝数据连接，也可以使用该Kit提供的对应模块
拉起系统拨号界面并预填电话号码 / Open the system dialer with a prefilled phone number
监听来电去电和通话接通挂断状态变化 / Monitor incoming and outgoing call state changes and call connect or hangup events
发送文本短信或 multipart 长短信给指定联系人 / Send text SMS or multipart long messages to a specific contact
读取当前蜂窝网络运营商名称和信号强度 / Get the current cellular carrier name and signal strength
获取 SIM 卡运营商、国家码和卡状态信息 / Retrieve SIM card carrier, country code, and card status information
判断设备是否支持短信发送和接收能力 / Check whether the device supports sending and receiving SMS
设置或查询短信中心号码 SMSC / Set or query the SMS service center address (SMSC)
检测电话号码是否属于紧急号码 / Validate whether a phone number is an emergency number
查询移动数据是否已开启并管理蜂窝数据连接 / Check whether mobile data is enabled and manage cellular data connections
订阅网络注册状态变化并更新运营商显示 / Subscribe to network registration state changes and update carrier display
获取当前语音网络或数据网络的服务状态 / Get the current voice network or data network service state
基于 telephony API 显示通话状态、SIM 信息和信号信息 / Display call state, SIM info, and signal details with telephony APIs
preconditions: 工程已集成 Telephony Kit 对应SDK能力，且目标设备支持蜂窝通信或相关模块能力 / The project includes the Telephony Kit SDK capability, and the target device supports cellular communication or the relevant module capability
module.json5 中已声明所需权限，且涉及受限能力时用户或系统已授予相应权限 / Required permissions are declared in module.json5, and the user or system has granted any needed restricted permissions
若涉及短信发送、蜂窝数据、SIM或eSIM操作，设备存在可用运营商能力且相关服务处于可用状态 / For SMS sending, cellular data, SIM, or eSIM operations, the device must have available carrier capability and the related service must be available
inputs: 短信内容或短信对象 / SMS content or SMS object
SIM卡槽位或订阅标识 / SIM slot or subscription identifier
需要查询或设置的蜂窝网络参数 / cellular network parameters to query or set

postconditions.statement: 代码已引入 Telephony Kit 相关模块，并调用了与目标任务匹配的电话/短信/蜂窝接口 / The code imports Telephony Kit modules and invokes call/SMS/cellular APIs matching the target task
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set show imports/usages from Telephony Kit (such as call, sms, radio, data, sim, or esim) and do those API calls match the requested telephony task?

postconditions.statement: 已补充或更新完成该能力所需的权限声明或运行时授权处理 / Required permission declarations or runtime authorization handling for the telephony capability have been added or updated
postconditions.judge_prompt: By inspecting the edits, were the necessary telephony-related permissions added to configuration files or was runtime permission handling introduced where needed?

postconditions.statement: 对异步结果、失败场景或状态变化进行了处理，例如回调、订阅、Promise结果或错误分支 / Asynchronous results, failure cases, or state changes are handled, such as callbacks, subscriptions, Promise results, or error branches
postconditions.judge_prompt: Do the edits include handling for success/failure or state updates around the telephony API call, such as callbacks, event listeners, try/catch, or Promise handling?
